title: Unlocking High-Accuracy Differentially Private Image Classification through Scale
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not conduct any benchmarks related to faith or religion. It measures image classification accuracy on standard computer vision datasets.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, faith, or religious bias. The research is focused on techniques for improving the accuracy of differentially private image classification models.
